task.question: What is the location of the photography installations for Images Vevey 2026?
task.evidence: Every two years, on the shores of Lake Geneva at the foot of the Swiss Alps, the town of Vevey transforms its public spaces and buildings with 50 installations of artistic projects from 21 countries, which are free and open to the public. With such a breathtaking natural setting as its backdrop, the photography displayed at Images Vevey has to strike its own particular note of magnificence to hold the gaze.
task.page: We Are Family: photography from Images Vevey 2026 – picture essay

answer:
The photography installations for Images Vevey 2026 will be located in the idyllic Swiss lakeside town of Vevey. 

FINAL: Vevey, Switzerland
